parsed.note_claim: The video shows a Corpus Christi (Boże Ciało) Catholic religious procession in Poland where participants kneel as the Blessed Sacrament passes.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The procession leaves the church after the main mass of the day. It is led by a priest with an uplifted monstrance in his hands.
parsed.reason: The page describes the Corpus Christi procession in Poland led by a priest with the Blessed Sacrament, substantiating the note's identification of the event.
